name: file-tree
description: A file tree pane with git status, search, keyboard navigation, shimmer on files Claude touches, previews, diffs and git-operation status

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers: reads (Read tool or Bash readers like cat and rg) in purple, writes in orange

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the cursor and tree move to what Claude reads or writes. off: the view stays where you put it

start.title: Open at start
start.description: on: the pane opens when a session starts. off: only /file-tree opens it

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows: date, age or size; the Σ button and z cycle it

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto: plain Unicode on the desktop app, Nerd Font elsewhere. nerd or plain forces one

open.title: Open with
open.description: preview shows a file in the pane. Anything else is a command run on the file: {path} is the file, otherwise the path goes last; words split on spaces, no shell. It runs where the session runs

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: Names to leave out of the tree and search, separated by spaces or commas, besides .git, node_modules and .tmp. Example: .cache dist
